mapper.select: SELECT tl.id, tl.content as title, COALESCE(tl.preview_image, 'https://via.placeholder.com/320x180/0a66c2/ffffff?text=课程') as thumbnail, COALESCE(tl.video_url, '') as videoUrl, CASE WHEN tl.video_duration > 0 THEN CONCAT(LPAD(FLOOR(tl.video_duration / 60), 2, '0'), ':', LPAD(tl.video_duration % 60, 2, '0')) ELSE '00:00' END as duration, DATE_FORMAT(tl.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as recordedAt, c.name as className FROM teacher_lesson tl LEFT JOIN `class` c ON c.id = tl.class_id WHERE tl.class_id = CAST(#{classId} AS UNSIGNED) AND tl.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY tl.created_at DESC

SELECT id, title, description, @rownum := @rownum + 1 as orderNum, (demo_video_url IS NOT NULL AND demo_video_url != '') as hasVideo, COALESCE(demo_video_url, '') as videoUrl, lesson_id as lessonId FROM teacher_knowledge_points, (SELECT @rownum := 0) r WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, content, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as createdAt, lesson_id as lessonId FROM teacher_classroom_notes WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teacher_knowledge_points (lesson_id, title, description, demo_video_url, created_at) VALUES (#{input.lessonId}, #{input.title}, #{input.description}, #{input.demoVideoUrl}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE teacher_knowledge_points SET demo_video_url = #{videoUrl} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teacher_classroom_notes (lesson_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{input.lessonId}, #{input.content}, NOW())

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FROM student s INNER JOIN `class` c ON c.id = s.class_id INNER JOIN teacher_lesson tl ON tl.class_id = c.id WHERE tl.id = #{videoId}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FROM student s INNER JOIN `class` c ON c.id = s.class_id INNER JOIN teacher_lesson tl ON tl.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ai_training_plans p ON p.student_id = s.id AND p.lesson_id = tl.id WHERE tl.id = #{videoId} AND (p.id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shuttlecock_skills ss WHERE ss.student_id = s.id AND ss.updated_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ))
